Toloka Visual Question Answering / WSDMCup2023

benchmark.hf.toloka.wsdmcup2023

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Actual bounded family admission review of complete creator card at8afd3c854c3ac246be112e1a055fb5efaefb0e96and primary challenge protocol main body establishes one Toloka VQA/WSDMCup2023 family across named mirrors. Question/image/box instances and train_sample subset remain distinct from workers or extra families. The original five exact qualified scientific statements have separate author/source-verifier/adversarial content receipts. Source-reported CC-BY release, human baseline and IoU do not establish audited per-image permissions, operational supplier effectiveness or reproduced scores; payload and remaining bibliography remain unread. This is a source-content family disposition, not an underlying corpus audit or admission of the separate CEUR paper work.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Toloka Visual Question Answering / WSDMCup2023 · documents: The paper describes crowd workers choosing interesting objects/images, composing English questions and drawing the answer bounding boxes from scratch on a CC-BY COCO image subset.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.hf.toloka.wsdmcup2023.crowd-construction

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • This is human question/box annotation, not expert professional work or synthetic question generation; self-reported English eligibility does not verify native proficiency.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Toloka Visual Question Answering / WSDMCup2023 · documents: The challenge scores predicted bounding boxes with mean intersection-over-union; its paper separately reports a crowd baseline and annotation agreement using a 1-IoU distance.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.hf.toloka.wsdmcup2023.iou-protocol-and-baseline

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • IoU, a crowd baseline and agreement coefficients are different statistics, not a universal accuracy or commercial annotation-quality guarantee.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Toloka Visual Question Answering / WSDMCup2023 · documents: The paper explicitly checked overlap with COCO boxes and placed overlapping cases in the training set, then released the same complete dataset with ground truth through Zenodo, Hugging Face, Kaggle and GitHub.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.hf.toloka.wsdmcup2023.overlap-and-mirror-identity

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • The listed delivery hosts, benchmark and dataset manifestations remain one selected family; source COCO images do not become newly collected photos.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Toloka Visual Question Answering / WSDMCup2023 · documents: The creator challenge paper describes 45,199 image-question-box instances: 38,990 train, 1,705 public test and 4,504 private test.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.hf.toloka.wsdmcup2023.split-and-instance-units

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • The card’s 1,000-example train_sample is a subset, not an additive split or another family. Counts describe instances, not workers.
